title: Self-Evolving Visual Agent via Margin Reward
abstract: arXiv:2610.15084v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Visual agents that interleave reasoning with tool invocation have posed a promising direction for multimodal tasks. However, learning effective tool invocation usually relies on curated question-answer pairs or expert demonstrations at scale, which are expensive to acquire. In this study, we propose Marvo, a simple-yet-effective self-evolution approach that enables learning tool invocation from unlabeled images. Marvo consists of two agents: (1) a challenger that generates question-answer pairs from unlabeled images, and (2) a solver that learns tool invocation by solving questions through reinforcement learning. To encourage effective tool invocation, a good training question should be difficult enough to warrant tool use, yet remain within the solver's capabilities. translated_title: 基于边际奖励的自我进化视觉智能体
translated_abstract: 将推理与工具调用交替进行的视觉智能体为多模态任务提供了一个有前景的方向。然而，学习有效的工具调用通常依赖于大规模精心整理的问答对或专家演示，这些数据获取成本高昂。在本研究中，我们提出了Marvo，一种简单而有效的自我进化方法，能够从无标注图像中学习工具调用。Marvo由两个智能体组成：（1）一个“挑战者”，负责从无标注图像中生成问答对；（2）一个“求解者”，通过强化学习解答问题来学习工具调用。为了鼓励有效的工具调用，一个好的训练问题应该足够困难以至于需要使用工具，同时又保持在求解者的能力范围之内。为此，我们为挑战者引入了边际奖励，其定义为求解者在有无工具情况下的性能差异。借助边际奖励，我们构建了
tldr: 提出了Marvo框架，通过挑战者-求解者双智能体协作和边际奖励机制，无需人工标注数据即可从无标注图像中自我进化地学习有效的工具调用能力。
en_tdlr: Marvo is a simple-yet-effective self-evolving visual agent framework that learns tool invocation from unlabeled images through a challenger-solver setup guided by a margin reward.
